description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of tests for verifying git archive attribute patterns. It sets up various git attributes and directory structures, then extracts a tar archive and checks which files are present or missing based on the attribute patterns.

methods.name: test_expect_exists
methods.description: Checks if the specified file or directory exists.

methods.name: test_expect_missing
methods.description: Checks if the specified file or directory does not exist.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
